title: Fix the Direct Struct Comparison
description: The program should compare two Point structures for equality.
expectedBehavior: Since a and b have the same x and y values, the program should print 'Equal'.
actualProblem: C does not support comparing structs directly with ==; this is a compile error ('invalid operands to binary =='). Structs must be compared member by member.
explanation: Unlike primitive types, C structs have no built-in == comparison — the compiler doesn't know which fields should count toward 'equality'. Each relevant member must be compared explicitly, usually combined with &&.
